Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/test/10-advanced-features.scm:
     1	;; Test 10: Advanced features - Y combinator, quasiquote simulation, macros
     2	
     3	;; Y combinator for anonymous recursion
     4	(define Y
     5	  (lambda (f)
     6	    ((lambda (x) (f (lambda (y) ((x x) y))))
     7	     (lambda (x) (f (lambda (y) ((x x) y)))))))
     8	
     9	;; Factorial using Y combinator
    10	(display "Factorial using Y combinator:")
    11	(newline)
    12	(define fact-y
    13	  (Y (lambda (f)
    14	       (lambda (n)
    15	         (if (= n 0)
    16	             1
    17	             (* n (f (- n 1))))))))
    18	
    19	(display "5! = ")
    20	(display (fact-y 5))
    21	(newline)
    22	
    23	;; Quasiquote simulation using list operations
    24	(define (quasiquote-sim template)
    25	  ;; Simplified - just handles lists with 'unquote markers
    26	  template)
    27	
    28	;; Association lists and property lists
    29	(define person '((name . "John") (age . 30) (city . "NYC")))
    30	
    31	(define (assoc-get key alist)
    32	  (cond ((null? alist) #f)
    33	        ((eq? (car (car alist)) key) (cdr (car alist)))
    34	        (else (assoc-get key (cdr alist)))))
    35	
    36	(display "Person data:")
    37	(newline)
    38	(display "Name: ")
    39	(display (assoc-get 'name person))
    40	(newline)
    41	(display "Age: ")
    42	(display (assoc-get 'age person))
    43	(newline)
    44	
    45	;; Simple object system using closures
    46	(define (make-counter init)
    47	  (let ((count init))
    48	    (lambda (msg)
    49	      (cond ((eq? msg 'get) count)
    50	            ((eq? msg 'inc) (set! count (+ count 1)))
    51	            ((eq? msg 'reset) (set! count init))))))
    52	
    53	(define c1 (make-counter 0))
    54	(display "Counter object:")
    55	(newline)
    56	(c1 'inc)
    57	(c1 'inc)
    58	(display "After 2 increments: ")
    59	(display (c1 'get))
    60	(newline)
    61	(c1 'reset)
    62	(display "After reset: ")
    63	(display (c1 'get))
    64	(newline)
    65	
    66	;; Continuation-like behavior with callbacks
    67	(define (with-file filename mode callback)
    68	  (let ((f (fopen filename mode)))
    69	    (let ((result (callback f)))
    70	      (fclose f)
    71	      result)))
    72	
    73	(display "File handling with callback:")
    74	(newline)
    75	(with-file "callback-test.txt" "w"
    76	  (lambda (f)
    77	    (fdisplay f "Written with callback!")
    78	    (fputchr f 10)
    79	    #t))
    80	(display "File written successfully")
    81	(newline)
